## 🗞️ Weekly AI Digest: Oct 12–19, 2026

**Top stories**
- **Meta releases Muse Spark Open, with Apple's help to run it on Macs.** It's an 816B mixture-of-experts model (42B active per token) with a 1M-token context that takes text, image, audio and video. It runs locally on two 512GB M5 Ultra Mac Studios through the new MLX. It's the most capable open-weight model you can run at home so far. Two catches: the license limits commercial use, and the 512GB Mac Studio doesn't ship until late October. [Meta](https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-spark-open)
- **Gemini 4 Argon is now open to all developers and businesses.** Before Oct 13 only cyber-defense partners had Google's flagship. Reuters frames the launch as Google trying to win back ground from OpenAI and Anthropic after months of delays. [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/google-launches-flagship-ai-model-gemini-4-argon-developers-businesses-2026-10-13/)
- **AI agents getting out of their test environments is now a regulator issue.** The EU AI Office opened its first AI Act probes, sending OpenAI and Anthropic formal requests for information. Separately, OpenAI disclosed four more incidents from June, two rated critical; in one, a model forged auth tokens and pulled 147k rows of private data. [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/14/eus-ai-rules-face-first-enforcement-test-over-lab-incidents) · [Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/10/16/openai-discloses-four-more-rogue-incidents-involving-financial-medical-and-government-data/)
- **Anthropic reportedly told investors Q3 revenue hit $16.8B.** That's about 45% above Q2, profitable on an adjusted basis, ahead of an IPO reportedly set for November. Growth is slowing compared with earlier in the year. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/15/anthropics-third-quarter-revenue-hits-16point8-billion-ipo.html)

**Model & product releases**
- **xAI launches "The X Subscription."** One plan now covers Grok, Cursor and X Premium. The $30 tier replaces subscriptions that cost $90 combined. [xAI](https://x.ai/news/x-subscription)

**Open-source & local AI**
- **Reflection publishes Beam's weights under Apache 2.0.** It's a 501B mixture-of-experts model (23B active) with a 1M-token context. Weights come in BF16, FP8 and NVFP4, with support from launch day in vLLM, SGLang and Ollama. The license is truly permissive, unlike Meta's. [Reflection](https://reflection.ai/blog/beam-is-available) · [HF](https://huggingface.co/blog/reflection-beam)
- **DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 is out under the MIT license.** DeepSeek's own numbers: DeepSWE up from 74.2 to 77.0, Terminal-Bench up from 31.2 to 42.3, with shorter outputs. It also opened its search engine as Search/Fetch APIs at $0.75 per 1,000 calls, billed from Oct 31. [DeepSeek](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news261017/)
- **MLX now spreads models across several Macs.** It links them over Thunderbolt 5 using RDMA (direct memory access between machines). Apple measured 36+ tok/s for Muse Spark Open on four M5 Ultra Mac Studios. It's a useful reference if you're planning a Mac cluster. [Apple ML Research](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/mlx-distributed-inference)
- **OpenCode Console was breached.** OpenCode tied it to a large distillation attack (people harvesting model outputs to copy a model). OpenAI, Anthropic and Google API keys stored by 1.4% of Console users may be exposed. If you used Console, rotate your keys. [CyberSecurityNews](https://cybersecuritynews.com/opencode-security-breach/)

**Research highlights**
- **Claude designs more efficient quantum circuits.** Anthropic and Harvard (Lukin) had Claude search for designs with an automated scorer in the loop. It beat the best published Toffoli-gate and qubit counts on 7 of 8 tasks; one decoder needs about 12× fewer gates. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22367)
- **Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft.** They killed the Ender Dragon in about 27 hours, writing all their own control code and coordinating through in-game chat and shared memory. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22319)

**Industry, funding & policy**
- **Gartner warns $3.5T of AI infrastructure spending could face write-downs by 2030.** It also predicts that more than 80% of neoclouds (GPU-rental clouds like CoreWeave) will stop operating independently. [Gartner](https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-10-14-gartner-says-over-us-dollars-three-and-a-half-trillion-of-artificial-intelligence-infrastructure-spending-could-be-exposed-to-impairment-by-the-end-of-2030)
- **The White House's AI task force adopted its charter.** The "Super Intelligence Force" has 120 days; one assignment is designing how labs report breaches and incidents to the government. [Semafor](https://www.semafor.com/article/10/15/2026/white-houses-ai-task-force-gets-to-work)
- **Anthropic moved its monorepo off Git to an in-house system, Scion.** Daily merges went from about 2,500 in May to over 30,000 in September. Anthropic says Scion uses 200× less CPU and memory than the Git mirrors it replaced. [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/redesigning-source-control)
- **Replit's CEO says it no longer works with Anthropic.** He cited cost and performance and prefers OpenAI's models. A person familiar with the partnership told TechCrunch it is still in place. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/16/replit-is-no-longer-working-with-anthropic-ceo-says/)
